source.provenanceNote: Exact pinned OpenScriptures XML was re-fetched before this report; entry anchors and sense boundaries were cross-checked against the OpenScriptures BDB XML structure. This report pins lexical boundaries only and does not authorize Korean candidate, Registry, or production mutation.

targets.boundary: Keep plural-in-number uses such as rulers/judges, divine beings and gods distinct from intensive/singular-referential uses for God; grammatical number alone must not be turned into a theological inference.
targets.uncertainty: Root/etymological relationship around אל/אלהים is not a safe basis for candidate expansion.

targets.boundary: Primary lexical identity is the proper name of the God of Israel. Masoretic reading tradition and scholarly etymological proposals must remain provenance/context notes rather than replacing the proper-name identity.
targets.uncertainty: Do not convert a proposed derivation from הוה/היה into a settled lexical gloss.

targets.boundary: Distinguish individual father, head of household/clan, ancestor, originator/patron, figurative producer/protector, honorific and late ruler/chief uses. Divine-father reference is context-governed, not imported globally.
targets.uncertainty: The preceding root discussion a.ae.aa explicitly treats the proposed stem/explanation as doubtful; lexical candidate must not depend on that etymology.

targets.boundary: Separate son/male child, children, youth, young animal, figurative/member-of-class constructions and age/quality relational uses at context level.
Preserve happen/come to pass, come into being/become, exist/be, remain/continue and construction-sensitive predicative senses; clause context is required before Korean sense selection.
Lexical core is man/male-person; husband, person/individual and idiomatic extensions require actual Genesis context rather than a single flattened gloss.
targets.uncertainty: BDB's preceding root discussion a.da.aa marks the stem's existence/meaning and derivation as disputed; do not expose a speculative etymology as headword meaning.

targets.boundary: Separate woman, wife, female-of-animals and distributive/reciprocal uses. Relationship status must come from syntax/context, not the lemma alone.
targets.uncertainty: Root linkage belongs to provenance and must not control the Korean headword.

targets.boundary: Track Qal say/utter, inner speech/think, promise and command separately from passive be-said/told and other stem-specific senses; morphology and syntax are mandatory for token-level classification.
Primary root covers do/make and derived action/production/preparation/ordering ranges. Keep the separate press/squeeze homograph isolated and require morphology/context before sense assignment.
targets.uncertainty: Homograph separation is a hard boundary.

targets.boundary: Separate see/perceive/mental observation from appear/be seen and causative show/cause-to-see senses by stem and context; idiomatic extensions must not replace the lexical core.
